reviews.text: The doctor quickly and substantively understood our situation and ordered all necessary tests. She did not rush off-topic and always checked if we had more questions. Her approach felt attentive and professional.

reviews.text: The doctor is attentive, tactful, and a true professional. We wish her career success and hope she stays as kind and caring. We need more doctors like her.

reviews.text: A true professional who gives patients a lot of attention. Every prescription is explained in detail — why this drug and what to expect. We felt sincere involvement and care, which made the visit much less stressful.
